content: {"rule": "K-S2", "applies": "no", "applies_why": "The judge text does not ground UNDERDETERMINED on a single verse failing to state a link or its contrary; it instead cites the sentence's own words as stating the source.", "verdict": "CLEAN", "quote": "D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- the challenger's covenant-origin analogy is footed (1 Chronicles 28:6, Acts 1:8) but the sentence's own words state the source of what is in the womb; answered in [CR3] LINK 2.", "rule_words": "That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open.
